Excellent question! Following a few simple steps will ensure you get the best possible sleep experience from your new mattress. 💡

Here’s how to set it up for the best results:

Move the Box: It's easiest to unbox the mattress in the room where you plan to use it.
Unbox with Care: Place the box on its side and pull the mattress roll out. Be careful with any sharp objects!
Position and Unwrap: Place the rolled mattress on your firm, flat foundation or base. Remove the outer plastic wrap.
Unfold and Free: Tear away the inner plastic. A pro tip is to start at the top and pull it down like a sock.
Let it Expand: Your mattress will expand right away, but it can take up to an hour to fully expand and a few days to fully firm up. Any initial odor will dissipate quickly.
Rotate Regularly: To ensure even wear, we recommend rotating the mattress head-to-foot every 4-6 months.
